text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Creek and I both failed to claim victory.
And
yet...)

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Don't go thinking this is all done and
dusted!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Because next time, victory is mine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I know we'll cross paths once again, and
that
when we do, she'll be a stronger
opponent than
ever...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(When that day comes, I'm positive that
we'll both race with even more
determination than we did today, and
that we'll reach even greater 
possibilities!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Right now, the thought of such a race
brings me
joy and joy alone!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...It appears I'm going to have another
opponent
to best.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yaeno...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing that the next time we face
off
against each other, our battle will be
fiercer still.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But that's precisely what we're hoping
for, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That it is. That it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I shall be the one to claim
victory.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'll take that as a challenge to stop
you...
Because
that is what great rivals do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...Although my results today were
wanting, I did
make great strides on a
personal level.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I've learned that, right now, there are
many
potential rivals out there—many
racers whom I
wish to surpass.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, I learned that my races
with them are sure to be wonderful
occasions on which I can
run with every
fiber of my being.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I felt that today, with this very body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Absolutely overjoyed.
choice_data_list: Now that you've experienced that f...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Because as long as I have my cherished
rivals, the
limits available for me to
surpass will remain
infinite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And that means that the light I
emit—and the
dazzling trail I leave in my
wake—will shine on
into eternity!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a fierce race against strong
contenders she's never faced before, it
looks like Mejiro Ardan is
sensing signs
of growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her classic year draws to a close,
I bet the
upcoming clashes against her rivals
will become
even more intense.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It'd probably be best to give ourselves
some time
to build up Mejiro Ardan's
skills before running
another goal race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the traditional route? That race
determines
the finest medium-distance
runner of the spring,
doesn't it?
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Osaka Hai next.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I imagine it'll be another gathering of
brilliant
lights.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I am, but... Oh,
is it odd? For my heart to
be
racing so.
choice_data_list: I'm already looking forward to com...
I'm already looking forward to com...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm confident that her sheer enthusiasm
will turn
her running into something even
more dazzling to
behold.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If you think so, Trainer, then I shall
gladly
surrender myself to this jubilant
feeling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's go back right away and review
today's
events. I wish to look over
Creek's performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, an ecstatic Mejiro Ardan and I
make our
way back to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, unbeknownst to us...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: This year's Kikuka Sho did not disappoint. That was truly a staggering contest, and it's no surprise the fans are already eagerly awaiting these racers' next appearances...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Creek, Yaeno, and Ardan... They're all
getting
stronger and stronger...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: While I'm just...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (...It's okay. I can get stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (No. I have to get stronger...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...In order to become a worthy rival to
Chiyono
O when she returns to the races
someday!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai—there, I shall put on an
even
more radiant performance!
